title: Is Gemini 3 Really That Good?
description:
Gemini 3 is Google's SOTA AI LLM model, smashing past ChatGPT, Claude and Grok to top the AI leaderboards. But is it worth caring about or trying? Well, you almost certainly will as it is powering AI mode in Google search results, as well as the Gemini app and it's available in AI Studio too.
Here are 5 features I think are cool.
#ai #llm #aitools #googlegemini #artificialintelligence #tech #technology #learnontiktok #nanobanana #AIAgents
